Such scenarios have either implicitly or explicitly emerged in the recent literature: see e.g.

arxiv-2211-14476.title: Enumeration of Moiré Patterns of a Hexagonal Twisted Bilayer and Intercalated Transition Metals in Twisted h-BN
arxiv-2211-14476.creator: Matthew Ciesler, Damien West, Shengbai Zhang
arxiv-2211-14476.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matthew Ciesler, Damien West, Shengbai Zhang. A real-space method using generating integers is used to classify the possible moiré patterns for two equal hexagonal lattices. The result is that the rotations that take ( n , m ) (n,m) to ( m , n ) (m,n) with n , m n,m relatively prime form the fundamental moiré transformations, and the number of lattice coincidence areas within each supercell is given by ( n − m ) 2 (n-m)^{2} .

arxiv-2304-12107.title: Using multiobjective optimization to reconstruct interferometric data (I)
arxiv-2304-12107.creator: Hendrik Müller, Alejandro Mus, Andrei Lobanov
arxiv-2304-12107.description: Abstract Context. Imaging in radioastronomy is an ill-posed inverse problem. With the increasing sensitivity and telescopes capabilities, several strategies have been developed in order to solve this challenging problem. In particular, novel algorithms have been proposed recently using (constrained) nonlinear optimization and Bayesian inference. Aims.

arxiv-2401-01952.title: Instruct-Imagen : Image Generation with Multi-modal Instruction
arxiv-2401-01952.creator: Hexiang Hu, Kelvin C.K. Chan, Yu-Chuan Su, Wenhu Chen, Yandong Li, Kihyuk Sohn, Yang Zhao, Xue Ben, Boqing Gong, William Cohen, Ming-Wei Chang, Xuhui Jia, [4pt] Google DeepMind Google Research {hexiang,kelvinckchan,ycsu,wenhuchen}@google.com
arxiv-2401-01952.description: Abstract This paper presents Instruct-Imagen , a model that tackles heterogeneous image generation tasks and generalizes across unseen tasks. We introduce multi-modal instruction for image generation, a task representation articulating a range of generation intents with precision. It uses natural language to amalgamate disparate modalities ( e.g . , text, edge, style, subject, etc .

arxiv-2407-01873.title: Automated Text Scoring in the Age of Generative AI for the GPU-poor
arxiv-2407-01873.creator: Christopher Ormerod, Alexander Kwako
arxiv-2407-01873.description: Abstract Current research on generative language models (GLMs) for automated text scoring (ATS) has focused almost exclusively on querying proprietary models via Application Programming Interfaces (APIs). Yet such practices raise issues around transparency and security, and these methods offer little in the way of efficiency or customizability.

arxiv-2411-09515.title: Application of signal separation to diffraction image compression and serial crystallography
arxiv-2411-09515.creator: Julien, Nicolas, Samuel, Shibom, Alejandro, Gianluca, Daniele
arxiv-2411-09515.description: Abstract We present here a real-time analysis of diffraction images acquired at high frame-rate (925 Hz) and its application to macromolecular serial crystallography. The software uses a new signal separation algorithm, able to distinguish the amorphous (or powder diffraction) component from the diffraction signal originating from single crystals.

arxiv-2506-11586.title: 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝗢𝗡𝗡𝗱𝘀 \boldsymbol{\mathsf{SecONNds}} : Secure Outsourced Neural Network Inference on ImageNet
arxiv-2506-11586.creator: Shashank Balla
arxiv-2506-11586.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of outsourced neural network inference presents significant privacy challenges, as sensitive user data is processed on untrusted remote servers. Secure inference offers a privacy-preserving solution, but existing frameworks suffer from high computational overhead and communication costs, rendering them impractical for real-world deployment.

Structural modeling is a fundamental component of computational engineering science, in which even minor physical inconsistencies or specification violations may invalidate downstream simulations. The potential of large language models (LLMs) for automatic generation of modeling code has been demonstrated. However, non-executable or physically inconsistent outputs remain prevalent under stringent engineering constraints.

pmc-11313194.title: Preparation and Characterization of Oxide Nanotubes on Titanium Surface for Use in Controlled Drug Release Systems
pmc-11313194.creator: Patrycja Osak, Sandra Skwarek, Dariusz Łukowiec, Grzegorz Przeliorz, Bożena Łosiewicz
pmc-11313194.description: Preventing or treating infections at implantation sites where the risk of bacterial contamination is high requires the development of intelligent drug delivery systems. The objective of this work was to develop a production method and characterization of fourth-generation oxide nanotubes on titanium grade 4 surface as a potential drug carrier.

pmc-11641561.title: Telehealth Adoption Among Saudi Older Adults: A Qualitative Analysis of Utilization and Barriers
pmc-11641561.creator: Abdulaziz M Alodhialah, Ashwaq A Almutairi, Mohammed Almutairi, Skirmantė Sauliūnė, Mindaugas Stankūnas, Ramunė Kalėdienė
pmc-11641561.description: Background/Objectives: The rapid adoption of telehealth services has been significantly accelerated by the need for accessible healthcare solutions, especially among older adults. However, the utilization of telehealth remains limited in many regions, including Saudi Arabia. This study aims to identify the barriers and facilitators influencing telehealth adoption among older adults in Riyadh.

pmc-12547271.title: Assessing the neuroendocrine and psychological effects of acute everolimus administration in healthy male participants
pmc-12547271.creator: Lucie Jacquet, Anna Lena Friedel, Elisa Orth, Nathalie Reiser, Tina Hörbelt-Grünheidt, Sophie Wiczoreck, Oliver Witzke, Manfred Schedlowski, Marie Jakobs
pmc-12547271.description: Previous experimental studies have shown that immunosuppressive mechanistic target of rapamycin inhibitors can induce neuropsychological changes, such as anxiety and depression, in healthy rodents. Furthermore, psychiatric conditions including anxiety have been reported in transplant patients and healthy subjects receiving the mechanistic target of rapamycin inhibitor everolimus.

pmc-12643403.title: A Blended Educational Program to Promote Dialogue on Patient Safety Between Patient and Family Advisory Councils and Health Care Organizations: Codevelopment Study
pmc-12643403.creator: Yannick Blum, Larissa Brust, Matthias Weigl, Qëndresa Rramani Dervishi
pmc-12643403.description: BackgroundReducing patient harm and improving patient safety is a central objective in global health care. Effective communication and meaningful patient engagement are considered essential strategies to achieve this goal. However, implementation of structured and strategic patient engagement at the organizational level remains limited, particularly in the context of patient safety.

pmc-12716705.title: Machine learning-based risk prediction model for cognitive dysfunction in elderly individuals
pmc-12716705.creator: Lei Zhang, Xuan Xiang, Wei Chen, Haijun Miao, Ting Zou, Ruikai Wu, Xiaohui Zhou
pmc-12716705.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundWith the advancement of globalization, the prevalence of cognitive dysfunction in the elderly population has risen significantly. Early intervention may dramatically alleviate the disease burden and reduce economic costs associated with cognitive impairment. This study aims to construct a risk prediction model for cognitive dysfunction based on machine learning (ML) algorithms, providing healthcare professionals and patients with a more accurate and effective tool for risk assessment.MethodsThis study included 1,325 elderly participants who completed cognitive assessments and comprehensive laboratory blood tests.

pmc-13063947.title: Whole-genome sequence of an extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii strain, AB/Mali-Bko/NPHI-APR.10, isolated from Bamako, Mali, in 2025
pmc-13063947.creator: Cheickna Hamallah Dicko, Ibrehima Guindo, Mohamed Ag Baraika, Ousmane Kamena, Noumou Yakhouba Keita, Demba Koita, Alhadji Dicko, Mahamadou Abdou, Klema Marcel Kone, Aissata Boubakar Cisse, Rihab Festali, Idrissa Diawara
pmc-13063947.description: Acinetobacter baumannii is a leading cause of nosocomial infections and ranks first on the World Health Organization’s list of critical-priority pathogens for antimicrobial resistance, surveillance, and new drug development. We report the whole-genome assembly of an extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii from the blood of a 6-month-old child in Bamako, Mali.

pmc-13147032.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A312 CARDIAC PHOTON-COUNTING DETECTOR COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY IN ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE: DIAGNOSTIC ACCURACY FOR DETECTION OF LEFT ATRIAL APPENDAGE THROMBUS
pmc-13147032.creator: Annemarie Kirschfink, Mohamed Elhalal, Stefan Seidel, Stefanie Kammer, Dimah Hasan, Michael Frick, Nikolaus Marx, Jörg B Schulz, Martin Wiesmann, Ertunc Altiok, Hani Ridwan, Arno Reich, João Pinho
pmc-13147032.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsIn up to 1/3 of ischemic stroke patients no cause can be identified. Left atrial appendage (LAA) is the primary anatomical origin of cardiac embolism, yet it is often inadequately assessed in stroke etiological workup.

pmc-13462430.title: Development and external validation of a machine learning-based multimodal radiomics nomogram for predicting progression-free survival in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-13462430.creator: Yanhui Lu, Zhuolin Li, Weiyuan Zhang, Weiming Mao, Fanxin Fu, Wanting Wang, Chunyan Luo, Rongyan Zhou, Yu Guan, Bo He, Jun Li
pmc-13462430.description: BackgroundTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a highly aggressive subtype characterized by significant heterogeneity, making accurate prognostic assessment essential for clinical management. However, existing predictive models predominantly rely on single-modality data and lack external validation, which may limit their generalizability and clinical applicability.

pmc-13542567.title: Graphene Oxide–Hydroxyapatite Nanocomposite Coatings and Extracellular Matrix Protein Interactions for Enhanced Osseointegration in Dental Implants
pmc-13542567.creator: Ravinder S. Saini, Rayan Ibrahim H. Binduhayyim, Doni Dermawan, Masroor Ahmed Kanji, Syed Altafuddin Quadri, Artak Heboyan
pmc-13542567.description: Graphene oxide (GO) has been recognised to have a strong protein‐binding ability attributed to its high surface area and oxygen functional groups (OFGs) but is plagued with dose‐dependent cytotoxicity. In contrast, hydroxyapatite (HA) is highly biocompatible but has shown relatively weak protein–protein interactions on the molecular scale.

pmc-13559246.title: Breathing carcinogens: PM2.5 air pollution and lung cancer in never-smokers, a narrative review
pmc-13559246.creator: Ian G Christie, Adam C Soloff, Raul Caso
pmc-13559246.description: Background and ObjectiveLung cancer in never-smokers (LCINS) disproportionately affects women and younger individuals, and its incidence has increased over recent decades. Environmental respiratory hazards, such as particulate matter ≤2.5 µm (PM2.5), are associated with lung cancer incidence and mortality, but the mechanisms by which PM2.5 increases lung cancer susceptibility remain incompletely understood. This review summarizes the current evidence linking PM2.

pmc-13601776.title: Performance of Cloud-Hosted Large Vision-Language Models on the Japanese National Examination for Clinical Laboratory Technicians: Comparative Benchmarking Study
pmc-13601776.creator: Kota Murakami, Ryosuke Matsuzawa, Yuya Tahara-Arai, Haruka Ozaki, Stefano Brini
pmc-13601776.description: BackgroundCloud-hosted large vision-language models (LVLMs) often outperform open-weight models on multimodal benchmarks, but their applicability to health care examinations that require both text and image reasoning remains unclear. Existing studies on Japan’s National Examination for Clinical Laboratory Technicians mainly used text-only settings and a limited set of models.

pmc-13657577.title: Emerging gene therapies in the treatment of recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa: a systematic review
pmc-13657577.creator: Abolfazl Nikkhoy, Amirhossein Larijani, Erfan Rajabi, Hojat Eftekhari
pmc-13657577.description: Background:Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) is a life-limiting collagen type VII alpha-1 (COL7A1)-related disorder characterized by skin fragility, chronic wounds, and early mortality. Gene therapies aim to restore collagen type VII (C7) expression and improve wound healing, but clinical evidence remains limited.Objective:To synthesize current evidence on the safety and effectiveness of gene therapy approaches for RDEB.
